instruction: Could you help me create a PDF from this spreadsheet? I need all the cells resized to fit everything on a single page for efficient viewing. Save the PDF with the spreadsheet's name in my home folder.

metadata.explanation: User-friendly request format. Evaluator confirms single-page PDF creation at correct location.
metadata.verification_details: Uses existing check_pdf_pages metric to verify: (1) PDF file exists at /home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.pdf, (2) PDF has exactly 1 page (relation=eq, ref_value=1), (3) PDF file size > 10KB (verify_content=True). No custom functions needed as check_pdf_pages is already available in desktop_env.evaluators.metrics.pdf.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: The check_pdf_pages metric with verify_content=true checks for embedded images in the PDF (lines 46-58 in pdf.py), but LibreOffice Calc exports to PDF create text/vector-based PDFs, not image-based PDFs. Spreadsheet content (cells, text, numbers) is rendered as PDF text and vector graphics, not as raster images.

The evaluator will incorrectly return 0.0 even when a valid single-page PDF is created from the spreadsheet, because the image check at line 57-58 will fail (has_images=False for normal spreadsheet PDFs).

Missing verification: The instruction requires 'all cells resized to fit everything on a single page' but the evaluator only checks page count, not whether cells were actually resized or if content fits properly.
The verify_content flag is semantically incorrect for this use case - it was likely designed for image-to-PDF conversion tasks, not spreadsheet-to-PDF conversion.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove the verify_content=true flag, or change check_pdf_pages logic to not require images for spreadsheet PDFs (only check file size > 10KB, skip image verification)
Consider adding a custom metric that verifies the PDF contains text content from the spreadsheet (e.g., extract text and check for non-empty content)
Alternatively, use a simpler verification that only checks: (1) file exists, (2) page count = 1, (3) file size > reasonable threshold (e.g., 5KB)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_pages first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
